title: Gavia Fondo 1 Tubeless Tyre
notes: Official UK store read 2026-11-01: £44.99; sizes 700x28c and 700x32c; 'Hookless compatible'. Same winter, wet and mixed-terrain positioning as the Fondo 0, with a 60 TPI casing, RR-E compound and R-Shield. 700x28C 80-105 psi (5.5-7.2 bar), about 395 g; 700x32C 50-75 psi (3.5-5.1 bar), about 445 g.
